text_block_list.text:
One day, while preparations for the Make 
Debut were underway.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes... Please.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Flight-san is taking another break? 
Didn't she just rest a moment ago? I hope 
she's okay...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, is this really the time to be 
worrying about others? You seem to have 
energy to spare... so how about two extra 
laps? I'll build you right up before your 
debut!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wah! ...I'm going for extra laps!!

Due to her constitution, North Flight can 
only progress through training with 
frequent breaks. Deep down, she must feel 
some frustration, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I've been with this body for a loooong 
time, so♪ I know it inside and out.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Rest up properly, and take it one step at 
a time—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-shiin!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh? This voice...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that concludes our vocal 
warm-ups! Now, let's keep going!

Her name is Sakura Bakushin O... North 
Flight's classmate, and a headlong, 
unstoppable class representative.

She's one generation ahead of North Flight 
and has already made her debut.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please recite along with me! The 
Bakushin-style Tracen Academy Rules—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Step 1: Bakushin! Step 2: Bakushin! Steps 
3 and 4: Bakushin! Step 5: Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text:
Step 1: Bakushin! Step 2: Bakushin! Steps 
3 and 4: Bakushin! Step 5: Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I know you must all be anxious having just 
enrolled at Tracen Academy. Howeveeer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep those rules in mind, 
you'll thrive as a model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just like me! The exemplary class 
representative, Sakura Bakushin O!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh my! Look who we have here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If it isn't Flight-san! Good afternoon!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Bakushin O-chan! You're full of 
energy today too, as always.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's my strong point! Being 
energetic is great, isn't it? Very 
exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's scatter them to everyone as well! 
Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That is intriguing. Let's follow them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heeey everyone! Good afternoon, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm! Someone who looks unwell, straight 
ahead to the right!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... Hm? Me...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "BAKUSHIIIN!! Are you all riiiight?!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? T-Teleportation...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! You're looking awfully pale! Allow me 
to bestow upon you Bakushin Vigorous 
Energy! Here you go!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... thank you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it turned cherry blossom pink! Now on 
to scattering the next batch!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...
choice_data_list:
…Shall we watch over them just a little 
longer?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you so much—

And so, Sakura Bakushin O continues to 
spread energy wherever she goes. What's 
most noteworthy—is her speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, when did we get on the track!? 
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing left to do but Bakushin! 
BAKUSHEEEEEN!

Sakura Bakushin O has been delivering 
results in the sprint division ever since 
her debut. She is especially formidable in 
sprints up to 1200m.

She will surely accomplish even greater 
things moving forward. She's bound to 
emerge at the top of GⅠ races too... Her 
core philosophy overlaps with North 
Flight's.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Too bad. I still can't catch up to you 
just yet.

Sprinters up to 1,200m, and milers up to 
1,600m... Strictly speaking, they belong 
to slightly different realms, but—

It wasn't a common concept yet, and both 
were treated as sprint routes.

Her goal is the 1600m mile. Eventually, 
she will inevitably clash with Sakura 
Bakushin O, who is on the same path.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan is so stylish, after all.

Sakura Bakushin O doesn't really strike me 
as the fashion-conscious type. North 
Flight would probably know more about it, 
but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's stylish. Ever since we first met... 
always.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Yes, sir!! It is I, Sakura Bakushin O!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, everyone! Starting today, this 
class shall be called truly exemplary! And 
why? Because—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Because I, myself, shall become the Class 
Representative!!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since the first time I met her... 
Bakushin O-chan was a special girl who 
sparkled so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty then! Dear classmates, feast 
your eyes on this!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
""I'll prove that I'm worthy of being 
class rep! Starting right now with a 
1,200m sprint!""

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Something just started... What are they 
trying to prove?"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"For a class rep, usually it's about being 
serious or well-behaved, right? Why 
running?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Haaahaahaa!! How naive of you all!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
""What I'm going to prove is... naturally, 
'Speed'!""

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Chowaaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Why does she shine so uniquely...? The 
answer lies in her overwhelming speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Being fast is amazing! Being amazing is 
exemplary!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I am! A truly wonderful! 
Exemplary class representative! Ahem!"

text_block_list.name: Classmates A & B
text_block_list.text: "O-Oh, yeah..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Heart, ability, body. All elements come 
together in a flawless coordination 
tailored for speed—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—There's nobody else out there as stylish 
as her.

The meaning of fashion that North Flight 
speaks of. It must refer to someone who 
brings out the best in their natural self, 
radiating their absolute greatest 
brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flight-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm off to go spread some more cheer! See 
you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I still can't compete with her. 
My place is right here. But still...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to pit my raw material... 
my speed, against her.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—In my best-coordinated outfit. I want to 
run with her...

Eyes overflowing with brilliance gazed 
after Sakura Bakushin O's retreating 
figure for a long, long time—
